label: persist_full_vector setting
type: index setting that keeps a copy of the full unquantized vector alongside the quantized one, which reranking requires
note: Kept in vector-search: rather than moved to a cross-cutting setting: namespace. setting: currently has three unpromoted members drawn from three unrelated areas (indexer defer-build, curl allowed-URL access, a stream size limit) and no promoted member at all, so filing here would assert that all cluster settings form one axis - which no page states. That question is the next namespace this pass should take; filing a vector setting into an unbuilt axis first would mean filing it twice. The five other vector index settings (nList, nProbes, train_list, replicas, partitions) are on the watchlist at recurrence 1 and must go wherever this one ends up.
relates_to_competency_question: What can I tune on a vector index, and what does it cost?
